english.title: Use a goods vehicle on a road when the ministry test date disc was not displayed / legible on the vehicle trailer
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a goods vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when the test date disc issued, following the issue of a goods vehicle test certificate, in respect of a trailer to which the Plating and Testing Regulations apply and for which a plating certificate had been issued

(A)_[was not displayed]_
(B)_[was not in a legible condition and in a conspicuous and readily accessible position in which it is clearly visible by daylight from the near side of the road]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 73(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
